summary.name: Metadatics
summary.one_liner: Metadatics is a macOS audio metadata editor for batch editing tags, fetching album artwork and metadata online, and renaming files from their tags.
use_cases: Batch editing tags on large music collections
Fetching album artwork and track info for untagged albums
Renaming and sorting music files into Artist/Album folders
Extracting embedded album art as image files
Cleaning up tag text with find-and-replace or sequence numbering
Preparing files with Windows-safe names for network shares
summary.what_it_does: Metadatics edits tags across MP3, M4A, AIFF, WAV, FLAC, APE, OGG, and WMA files, reading and writing ID3v1, ID3v2, MP4, Vorbis, APE, and ASF tag formats. It includes built-in bulk functions such as replacing text, trimming characters, generating number sequences, and copying between tags. It can look up album and track metadata and artwork online, with a preview before anything is written and a choice when multiple releases match. Files can be renamed or moved into directory structures built from tags, with options to replace characters invalid on Windows and preview renames before committing.
notable: Supports many audio formats and tag standards (ID3, MP4, Vorbis, APE, ASF)
Fetches album artwork from iTunes API and Discogs, with multiple images supported
Renames and builds directory structures from any combination of tags
Listed in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac under Audio and Video Tools
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; it links to the Mac App Store listing
